description: Transpower publishes point locations for sites including AC stations, DC stations and tees on New Zealand’s national transmission grid. Layer fields describe asset location, type, status and description. These are site representations and do not establish bus connectivity, equipment ratings or current operation. The source relates them to the provider’s high-voltage transmission network, whose lines, structures and spans are separately described. Coverage is New Zealand. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, with accuracy and completeness caveats. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides mapped infrastructure or service inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing Transpower transmission-lines record.
